This period at a glance

Auto-generated from the data currently loaded and filtered above

Between 2026-08-01 and 2026-08-10, the kitchens logged 563 complaints against 39,518 units sold — a blended rate of 1.42%. Plus Mall Kitchen ran hottest at 2.00%, while Maadi Kitchen was lowest at 1.13%. Product Quality was the leading complaint category (38% of tickets), most often flagged as "Delivered Cold - Wrong Temperatur" (90 tickets). Pepperoni Pizza was the most persistent recurring issue, complained about on 8 of the 10 day(s) in this window. (194 tickets had no product named on them and are excluded from product-level figures.)
